title: Telesat enters into standstill arrangement with GEO lenders allowing Telesat additional time to address upcoming maturities | Telesat
body_markdown:
**OTTAWA, CANADA – November 16, 2026** – Telesat Corporation (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT), one of the world’s largest and most innovative satellite operators, today announced that Telesat and an ad-hoc committee of holders of Telesat GEO Inc.’s term loans, secured notes, and unsecured notes agreed to standstill arrangements, which include that the lenders will not take any enforcement actions through and including January 18, 2027. Telesat agreed in the standstill arrangements to continue to make interest payments during the standstill period.


Telesat’s term loans and certain secured notes mature December 6, 2026. Telesat’s goal remains reaching a fair and consensual resolution. The standstill arrangements afford Telesat additional time to address the upcoming maturities. To that end, Telesat will continue to seek to engage in good faith in respect of the upcoming debt maturities.
